status: Two-source formation brief checked; authoring and native review pending.
method: Read publisher attachments and explanations, distinguish separate homographs before using a URL, and author original examples. Editorial levels are not an official syllabus.

points.formation: Verb て/で + も; i-adjective くても (いい→よくても); noun/na-adjective でも. Negative なくても or nominal でなくても/じゃなくても.
points.teachingChoice: N4 bridge from permission/non-obligation: teach unchanged outcome under actual or hypothetical concession. Do not assert that ても always hypothetical or never allows a request.

points.formation: Plain verb/i-adjective clause + のに; present affirmative noun/na-adjective + なのに. Past nominal だったのに, negative nominal ではないのに.
points.teachingChoice: Retrieve N4 u10. Contrasting facts/expectations, with disappointment possible but not mandatory. The separate purpose/requirement のに page is not this construction. Do not infer facts absent from the scene or score overlapping concession synonyms as uniquely right.

points.formation: Attributive verb/i-adjective + くせに; noun のくせに; na-adjective なくせに. Past clauses attach directly.
points.teachingChoice: Recognise an accusation between peers, then repair it. No gender, age, nationality or status stereotypes in examples. It can sound insulting; do not present it as a polite default to a supervisor. A quoted accusation is the speaker's claim, not narrator-certified intent.

points.formation: Verb stem + ながらも, progressive ていながらも; i-adjective, na-adjective stem or noun + ながらも. Teach established coexisting-state/recognition uses.
points.teachingChoice: Contrast compatible simultaneous actions with concessive states, using 小さいながらも and 不器用ながらも. Avoid an absolute ban derived from simplified verb-state explanations. Residual 残念ながら is not treated as a productive concession plus も.
